import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_dvd_iff_pow_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p k : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) :
  (p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := h
    have h₂ : n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
      
      have h₃ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := h₁
      have h₄ : (n : ℤ) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
        rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
        exact h₃
      
      have h₅ : (n : ℤ) ^ k ≡ 0 ^ k [ZMOD p] := by
        
        exact Int.ModEq.pow k h₄
      
      have h₆ : (0 : ℤ) ^ k = 0 := by
        cases k with
        | zero => contradiction 
        | succ k' =>
          simp
      
      rw [h₆] at h₅
      exact h₅
    exact h₂
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := h
    have h₂ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
      
      have h₃ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k := by
        rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd] at h₁
        exact h₁
      have h₄ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
        
        have h₅ : Nat.Prime p := hp
        have h₆ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k := h₃
        have h₇ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
          
          exact (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by simpa using h₅)).dvd_of_dvd_pow h₆
        exact h₇
      exact h₄
    exact h₂

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_dvd_iff_pow_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p k : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) :
  (p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  have h_main : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := h
      have h₂ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k := dvd_pow h₁ (by linarith)
      rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact h₂
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k := by
        rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
        exact h
      have h₂ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
        
        have h₃ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k := h₁
        have h₄ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
          
          apply (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hp)).dvd_of_dvd_pow
          exact h₃
        exact h₄
      exact h₂
  exact h_main

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_dvd_iff_pow_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p k : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) :
  (p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
      omega
    exact dvd_pow h hk0
  · intro h
    exact Int.Prime.dvd_pow' hp h

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_dvd_iff_pow_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p k : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) :
  (p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact dvd_pow h (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)
  · intro h
    apply Int.natCast_dvd.mpr
    have hpabs : p ∣ (n ^ k).natAbs :=
      Int.natCast_dvd.mp h
    apply hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow
    simpa [Int.natAbs_pow] using hpabs

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_dvd_iff_pow_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p k : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) :
  (p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
    simpa only [zero_sub] using (dvd_neg.mpr (dvd_pow h hk.ne'))
  · intro h
    have hdneg := Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mp h
    simp only [zero_sub] at hdneg
    exact Int.Prime.dvd_pow' hp (dvd_neg.mp hdneg)
